integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; the included script is supplementary finite-precision verification
integrity.novelty_scope: Exact threshold and count law for the GC2 region at the \(2:1:1\) dilation only; the source GC2 inequality, rational GC1 infinitude, and later Bethe-Sommerfeld constructions are prior work.

scientific_limitations: The classification concerns only the GC2-certifying set in positive energy for the fixed ratio \(a:b:c=2:1:1\).
GC1 generates infinitely many gaps for every nonzero coupling at this rational ratio, so the result is not a finite-total-gap theorem.
The proof does not cover other rational ratios, unequal \(b\) and \(c\), or negative energies.
An equivalent special-case simplification may exist in unindexed notes or literature.
title: Exact GC2 threshold count for a commensurately dilated honeycomb quantum graph
